about_the_game:
Tales of Survival Horror: Chapter One – Demo puts you in the rain-soaked boots of Liam Carter, a desperate father searching a decaying biotech facility for his missing daughter.

Navigate a maze of locked doors, eerie power failures, and hidden puzzles while uncovering the dark past of Onyx Biotech. Resource scarcity adds tension to every decision.

This demo introduces the core mechanics:
🔸 Atmospheric exploration in a thunderstorm-drenched facility
🔸 Combat with limited ammo.
🔸 Solvable environmental puzzles including padlocks, fuse boxes & electric gates

Chapter One Demo ends with a chilling encounter that teases what's coming next — a glimpse into something much larger, much darker, and far more dangerous than Liam ever imagined.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
